name: Fehu
upright_meaning: Fehu is circulating wealth, primal fire, and active nourishment. It calls for purposeful reinvestment.
shadow_meaning: Material stagnation, scarcity dread, hoarding, or energy squandered through carelessness.

name: Uruz
upright_meaning: Uruz embodies the untamed strength and physical fortitude of the aurochs. Regeneration and physical vitality.
shadow_meaning: Brute hostility, misdirected vigor, stubborn resistance to necessary change, or exhaustion.

name: Thurisaz
upright_meaning: Thurisaz is the reactive barrier and the hammer strike. Decisive protective force and threshold vigilance.
shadow_meaning: Compulsive violence, vulnerability, crossing boundaries without discipline, or victimization.

name: Ansuz
upright_meaning: Ansuz represents the inspired voice, sacred transmission, and sovereign wisdom. Attune to guidance.
shadow_meaning: Distortion of truth, demagoguery, cognitive dissonance, or manipulation of words.

name: Raidho
upright_meaning: Raidho represents the wagon journey, cosmic rhythm, and alignment with rightful natural law.
shadow_meaning: Stasis, mechanical paralysis, disruption of flow, or traveling the wrong path blindly.

name: Kenaz
upright_meaning: Kenaz is the controlled flame of the artisan. Clear technical insight, sharp perception, and craft.
shadow_meaning: The torch extinguished, intellectual arrogance, burnt bridges, or hidden fires consuming discipline.

name: Gebo
upright_meaning: Gebo represents mutual respect, equal honor, and covenant. A gift demands a gift to preserve equilibrium.
shadow_meaning: Contemplative Shadow: Hidden transactional debt, boundary violation, or codependency masquerading as generosity.

name: Wunjo
upright_meaning: Wunjo represents communal celebration, friction-free alignment, and contentment born of good labor.
shadow_meaning: Alienation, manufactured cheer, toxic tribalism, or mourning over lost cohesion.

name: Hagalaz
upright_meaning: Hagalaz is the unyielding hailstorm that shatters brittle structures to clear the ground for true foundations.
shadow_meaning: Contemplative Shadow: Clinging to ruin, self-sabotaging chaos, or failure to extract wisdom from crisis.

name: Nauthiz
upright_meaning: Nauthiz is constraint forcing invention. Friction creates the spark; limitation reveals vital essence.
shadow_meaning: Hopeless fatalism, self-inflicted deprivations, or despair in the face of inevitable restraint.

name: Isa
upright_meaning: Isa is the ice sheet. Stillness is preservation, crystallizing clarity and halting momentum until the thaw.
shadow_meaning: Contemplative Shadow: Emotional numbness, paralysis, rigid entrenchment, and isolation.

name: Jera
upright_meaning: Jera is the turning season and earned yield. What was seeded with discipline is harvested in proper time.
shadow_meaning: Contemplative Shadow: Impatience with maturation, rushing outcomes, or failing to gather the harvest.

name: Eihwaz
upright_meaning: Eihwaz is the eternal yew: toxic yet life-giving, rooted in the underworld while supporting the heavens.
shadow_meaning: Contemplative Shadow: Existential terror of transformation, stubborn refusal to yield, or root rot.

name: Perthro
upright_meaning: Perthro is the casting horn of the Norns. Hidden variables align, inviting mastery of probability.
shadow_meaning: Reckless gambling, addictive reliance on chance, paranoia, or spiritual deception.

name: Algiz
upright_meaning: Algiz is the watchful sentry and the protective spear hedge. Clear spiritual boundaries and vigilance.
shadow_meaning: Lowering defenses, false security, vulnerability to intrusion, or paranoid suspicion.

name: Sowilo
upright_meaning: Sowilo is the blinding sun-wheel and sudden illumination. Absolute triumph, clarity, and sovereign vigor.
shadow_meaning: Contemplative Shadow: Burnout, blinding radiance, manic exhaustion, or scorch-earth pride.

name: Tiwaz
upright_meaning: Tiwaz is the arrow of justice and Tyr's sworn sacrifice. Decisive action aligned with cosmic law.
shadow_meaning: Fanaticism, dishonorable retreat, martyrdom without purpose, or corrupted authority.

name: Berkano
upright_meaning: Berkano is the birch bough and fertile earth. Gentle generation, healing, and patient maternal shelter.
shadow_meaning: Stifling overprotection, stagnation of creative seed, domestic discord, or decay.

name: Ehwaz
upright_meaning: Ehwaz is the sacred stallion and rider moving in unison. Synergy, unwavering allegiance, and steady progression.
shadow_meaning: Betrayal of trust, broken teamwork, bucking the rein, or erratic discord.

name: Mannaz
upright_meaning: Mannaz is consciousness, community intellect, and mortal potential. Know thyself within the collective.
shadow_meaning: Misanthropy, self-delusion, societal alienation, or hive-mind mediocrity.

name: Laguz
upright_meaning: Laguz is deep water and tidal intuition. Yielding to currents, subconscious depth, and fluid navigation.
shadow_meaning: Drowning in delusion, emotional paralysis, overwhelming tides, or murky deceit.

name: Ingwaz
upright_meaning: Ingwaz is the closed vessel and subterranean gestation. Creative potential gathers quietly until birth.
shadow_meaning: Contemplative Shadow: Premature unveiling, bursting before maturation, or suffocated vitality.

name: Dagaz
upright_meaning: Dagaz is the dawn twilight bridging day and night. Radical paradigm shift, awakening, and synthetic breakthrough.
shadow_meaning: Contemplative Shadow: Hesitation at the threshold, fear of total revelation, or returning to dark sleep.

name: Othala
upright_meaning: Othala is the inherited homeland and sovereign boundary. The cultural hearth, ancestral gifts, and defended domain.
shadow_meaning: Exclusion, xenophobic isolation, loss of ancestral root, or boundary failure.

name: Wyrd
upright_meaning: The Blank Rune. The void beyond mortal computation. Surrender to fate; the shuttle moves across the cosmic loom.
shadow_meaning: Contemplative Shadow: Fatalistic paralysis, surrender of agency, or dreading the unwritten horizon.
